title: MechWarrior 2
overview:
The year 3057. A battle we know nothing of awaits there.

The immersive battlefield of the future never lets go of those it has captured. Overcome grueling missions and seize the honor of a Mech warrior.

MechWarrior 2 puts you in the cockpit of a giant walking BattleMech. The Clans are at war with each other: join Clan Wolf or Clan Jade Falcon and fight their battle across distant worlds in first-person 3D combat.

Each mission sends you out to search and destroy, scout or strike enemy bases. Pick from a range of Mechs, from nimble light models like the Firemoth to sturdier medium machines, keep an eye on your heat as you fire, and grab power-ups for speed bursts, invincibility, stealth, faster reloads and repairs. This edition is tuned for fast arcade-style action.

- Two Clan campaigns
- Dozens of missions on alien worlds
- Power-ups for an arcade-style pace
- Mission Stick compatible

西暦3057年。
我々の知らないバトルがそこにある。

臨場感あふれる未来の戦場は、1度とらえた者を放さない。過酷な任務を克服し、メック戦士の名誉をつかめ。
